scenario: AITA for getting mad at my bf for always walking in front of me? | Everytime my boyfriend and I are walking somewhere, he tends to walk much faster than me. It’s hard to hear him or I’m struggling to keep up. I’ve brought it up to him multiple times but he says he just has longer strides (he’s maybe 6” taller than me) and can’t help it. We just went on vacation and walking around a new city, it was the same thing and I finally blew up at him saying that I don’t feel like his girlfriend when he won’t ever walk beside me. AITA and he really can’t help it?
